text: *Draft 1:* Last week, our local library's digital app crashed right when the most-awaited memoir dropped, leaving everyone unable to download their borrowed e-books. It was a frustrating glitch that showed how much we rely on these digital bridges. A server sync glitch left thousands of readers waiting in limbo. Fortunately, the IT team worked overnight to restore the de-sync and clear the cache. By Saturday morning, the holds were moving and the stories were flowing again. Digital access is fragile, but the community behind it is resilient.
